about: The falling spectrum of toys.json grown to 3 500 entries (simulated): row r < 140 is roll 2's value r (falling.rolls[2].values, sorted), rows 140-3 499 are bigRoll.extraValues (sorted), all in GeV, rounded to 5 decimals then stored as float32. A dk-hist reads it as a rows source: values 'falling-big.f32', key 'M', lo 1.45, hi 1.75, bin 0.01, ours false; {n: 140} is roll 2, {n: 3500} the grown set when the rows fill in file order. counts140 / counts3500 are what such a builder bins (Math.floor((v - lo) / bin)).
layout: little-endian float32, one column, rows in the order above

source.title: Seeded toy samples (simulated)
source.note: Simulated with numpy.random.default_rng; seeds are given with each sample. The flat level comes from record 401 (d0-flat.json).
